description: This PHP source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractInstallerVueController' for handling installation and upgrade procedures in a web application. It manages rendering templates with Twig, tracks installation steps, and handles some common logic for install and upgrade workflows within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerVueController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for managing installation and upgrade workflows using Vue.js templates within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Twig environment and context attributes, sets up template directories.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig Environment instance used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template filename to be used for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns a Vue component to this controller.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the attribute bag containing context parameters for rendering.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Placeholder for child class initialization logic.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook method executed before rendering, for pre-processing.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the assigned template with context data using Twig.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Coordinates pre-render, render, and post-render steps and returns a Response object.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Gathers parameters to populate the rendering context, including current step info.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Returns a version string for assets, based on build file contents or timestamp.

methods.name: getSteps
methods.description: Provides an array of steps depending on whether the process is an upgrade or new installation.

methods.name: getCurrentStep
methods.description: Determines the current step index based on the current screen state.
